steps.content: You wake up and find yourself once again enveloped by the omnipresent darkness.
You remember reporting the situation to Schorl and analyzing various possibilities. You should be awake now and away from this somber dream.
But the next moment, you slip into a slumber and return to the darkness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is something wrong with my memory? Could it be I have never woken up?
As your mind clears up gradually, you quickly dismiss the thought.
This is the dreamscape twisted by the phenomenon. Reality is on the other side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I see. So I'll always end up back here.
It's only a matter of time before Schorl notices the issue and wakes you up. You can choose to wait right here, or...

The nearby sounds become increasingly <color=#fb9259>rich</color>. Crying that feels too close to your ear, dreadful monster growls... More sounds pour into your ears. Crisp ringing of metal bells, unintelligible murmurs, human sobs...
Crossing through the darkness, you gradually make out the dim flame in the distance.
Despite its dimness, it's bright enough to illuminate this unnatural darkness. And the pitch-black terror accentuates its warmth and stability, evoking an irresistible longing, especially for you.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Keep your distance and observe with patience.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know how to handle it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But there's something I must do.
As you find your resolve, something turns its gaze upon you in the darkness.
The shackles' red light flickers, readying you for battle.
